name: Capsule / Cell Wall
description: The outermost protective layer of the E. coli bacterium. It provides structural support, prevents dehydration, and protects the cell from phagocytosis.

name: Nucleoid (DNA)
description: The irregularly shaped region within the cell where the genetic material (circular DNA) is localized. Unlike eukaryotes, it is not enclosed by a nuclear membrane.

name: Ribosomes
description: Complex molecular machines found within all living cells that serve as the site of biological protein synthesis (translation).

name: Flagella
description: Long, whip-like appendages used for cellular locomotion. E. coli has peritrichous flagella, meaning they are distributed over the entire surface of the cell.

name: Cytoplasm
description: The gel-like substance enclosed within the cell membrane. It contains the nucleoid, ribosomes, and various metabolic enzymes.
